_purpose: Stage 107A (Section E). Shared RFC-8785-scoped JCS canonicalization + SHA-256 test vectors, consumed identically by dserver/src/core/jcs.rs and DATUM/src/agent/jcs.rs to prove cross-crate digest stability, per the design-review requirement that DServer and SmartSentinel independently reconstruct and recompute the same digest. Each `sha256` value was computed independently of both Rust implementations via the system `sha256sum` over the exact `canonical` byte string, so this file is not circular verification against either crate.
